raw_comment:
Observation and Questions

We are surprised that the drought conditions of our state (Massachusetts) are matched by many other states. We know that there are many more wild fires in Massachusetts than usual. Is this also true in other draught areas?

It looks like the Appalachian and Rocky Mountain ranges may have some effect on drought. How do mountains affect drought?

Is the US draught caused by 
Climate change?
Pollution?
Pipelines?

Do wild fires produce air pollution?

What can kids do to reduce draught?

What can kids do to slow climate change?
